description: This file manages session-related data such as customer ID, store ID, currency, and language, providing functions to get, set, and reset these values, as well as constructing API request context headers.

methods.name: getOrCreateCustomerId
methods.description: Returns a persistent customer UUID, generating and storing a new one if none exists.

methods.name: resetCustomerId
methods.description: Removes existing customer ID and generates a new one.

methods.name: getOrCreateStoreId
methods.description: Returns a persisted store UUID or defaults to environment or fallback value.

methods.name: getOrCreateCurrency
methods.description: Returns a persisted currency code or defaults to USD.

methods.name: getOrCreateLanguage
methods.description: Returns a persisted language code or defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: getApiRequestContext
methods.description: Builds API request headers and query parameters based on session data.
